obligation.summary: High-risk AI systems must be designed to allow effective human oversight.

evidence_text:
Document A (System Design Spec, 2026-03-01): 'The system requires a human reviewer to approve every decision before it takes effect; the system cannot act autonomously.'

Document B (Operations Runbook, 2026-06-15): 'The system operates in fully automated mode in production; human review was disabled after the Q2 rollout to improve throughput.'
